profile.category: Non-accelerated filer · Smaller reporting company · Emerging growth company

intro.text: The Elmet Group is a U.S.-based provider of precision-engineered components and advanced high-energy systems for the Aerospace, Defense and Government, Industrial, Medical, Semiconductor and Electronics, and Energy industries. The Company operates through two segments, Critical Materials Components (CMC) and Engineered Microwave Products (EMP), leveraging materials science and precision engineering expertise to deliver high-performance solutions. The Elmet Group is dedicated to strengthening domestic manufacturing capabilities to support the U.S. and its allies’ needs in both critical materials and advanced high-power microwave systems.

s.t: The Binding Letter Agreement contemplates a joint venture to restart and operate the APT Plant at Blue Moon’s Springer tungsten project in Pershing County, Nevada (the “Springer Project”), and a total investment by the Company of up to $ 150.0 million, consisting of (i) an investment in Blue Moon (the “Blue Moon Investment”) and (ii) a contribution to a joint venture entity (the “JV Entity”) to be formed by the Company, Blue Moon and EQ.

As part of the Blue Moon Investment, we will provide Blue Moon’s group with a prepayment facility in the aggregate principal amount of approximately $50.0 million (the “Tungsten Prepayment Facility”), to be funded in two tranches as follows: (i) the first tranche, in the amount of $25.0 million (“BM Tranche 1”), shall be funded at the closing of the Tungsten Prepayment Facility;

The change in the fair value of forward instruments decreased approximately $0.2 million, or 100%, during the three and nine months ended October 2, 2026, compared to the prior year periods, due to the forwards related to the Blue Moon Investment and the Masan SHA.

The change in the fair value of forward instruments decreased approximately $0.2 million during the three and nine months ended October 2, 2026, compared to the prior year periods, due to the forward related to the Blue Moon Investment and the Masan SHA.
We will hold the Participation Right so long as we hold at least forty percent (40%) of the equity it purchased in the Blue Moon Investment (the “Ownership Condition”).

Pursuant to the Springer Agreement, we agreed to purchase, and Blue Moon has agreed to issue and sell, new equity in Blue Moon comprised of 3,500,000 units (the “Units”), within forty-five (45) calendar days of September 14, 2026, with each Unit to be comprised of one common share of Blue Moon (“BM Share”) and one Blue Moon Warrant at a price per unit of CAD 10.00 (the “Blue Moon Investment”).

On September 23, 2026, we entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement (the “SPA”) with Masan Horizon pursuant to which Masan Horizon Company Limited (“Masan Horizon”) agreed to issue and sell, and we agreed to purchase, a 4.99% interest in the total issued and outstanding voting ordinary shares of Masan, a public company incorporated in Vietnam and controlled subsidiary of Masan Horizon, or 55,138,174 ordinary shares (the “Masan Shares”) of Masan for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $124.8 (the “Masan Purchase Price”) pursuant to a put-through transaction on the UPCoM in accordance with applicable trading rules and regulations (the “Masan Investment”).

The proposed transactions include, among other matters, the formation of a joint venture to restart, expand and operate the Springer ammonium paratungstate plant (“APT Plant”), an equity investment by the Company in Blue Moon, tungsten concentrate supply arrangements, a tungsten prepayment facility, board representation rights and related commercial arrangements.

On October 1, 2025, the Company’s ownership interest in Poly Labs was distributed pro rata to the individual stockholders of the Company to focus financial and managerial efforts on the CMC and EMP divisions.

As the Company distributed its ownership interest in Poly Labs on October 1, 2025, there were no assets or liabilities, other than those noted above, related to Poly Labs that were included within the consolidated balance sheet as of October 2, 2026 or December 31, 2025.
As of October 2, 2026, neither the Blue Moon Investment nor the contribution to the JV Entity had closed.

The TEG Warrants were issued as consideration for Blue Moon’s entry into the Contemplated Agreements, most notably the expected license associated with the use of the APT plant (i.e., prepaid rent as the license does not contain recurring cash payments for the Company’s use of the plant and its related assets and its investment in the Company).
As part of the Blue Moon Investment, the Company and Blue Moon also entered into the BM Investor Rights Agreement.

• Establish independent U.S. midstream conversion capacity: Through the joint venture with Blue Moon and EQ, we intend to upgrade and restart the Springer APT plant, which would be the first independent APT plant in the United States that is not foreign-owned or tungsten-carbide focused.

• Secure and diversify feedstock: Our refining and trading division, along with our planned equity investment in each of Blue Moon and Masan, concentrate supply arrangements with EQ Resources and Blue Moon, offtake agreement with Tungsten West, and tungsten prepayment facility to Blue Moon (each as discussed below), are intended to enable us to source and allocate tungsten across allied geographies and reduce our exposure to a market in which China controls more than 85% of global supply and has imposed export restrictions that have driven tightening supply and price volatility.

The transactions contemplated under the Springer Agreement include: (i) the formation of the JV Entity among the Springer Parties to restart, expand and operate the APT Plant, (ii) an equity investment by us into Blue Moon, (iii) our receipt of board representation in both Blue Moon and the JV Entity;
On October 16, 2026, we entered into a subscription agreement with Blue Moon (the “BM Purchase Agreement”) to give effect to the Blue Moon Investment.
As part of the Blue Moon Investment, the Company and Blue Moon also entered into the BM Investor Rights Agreement (as defined below).
The closing of the Blue Moon Investment occurred on October 16, 2026.

Proceeds of the Blue Moon Investment will be limited to use solely in connection with the development of the projects being undertaken at Springer, with all mine and mill proceeds to be earmarked for tungsten development purposes only.
